source.set: the cluster reading index (#2228): every .md file under cfg_setting reading_index.roots, archive/ folders left out

source.not_included: the .csv files in origin-of-thought (not .md, so not in the reading index)

field_notes.kind_by_name: a hint from the file name only (reading, ledger, synthesis, data, process, admin, other); not a reading of the file
field_notes.index_state: the file against its reading_file row: current, changed since build, not in index, gone from disk
field_notes.distinct_verses: resolved verse references in the file (reading_ref, verse_id not null)
field_notes.capture_status: not started | in progress | captured | nothing to capture; set as the capture runs
field_notes.later_version: set when a later version of the same document is also in the set
